title: Prakrama 4, Sarga 25. Recapitulation of the Book: From the Birth of Sri Krishna to the Darshan of Gopinatha
html:
Murari lists the contents of the poem, from the reason for the Lord's descent to His return from Gauda to Puri and the darshan of Gopinatha

Verse 1

एतत्ते कथितं सूत्रं श्रीकृष्णचरितं द्विज।
वर्णयिष्यन्ति विस्तारैः श्रीवासाद्या महत्तमाः॥१॥

etatte kathitaṁ sūtraṁ śrīkṛṣṇacaritaṁ dvija|
varṇayiṣyanti vistāraiḥ śrīvāsādyā mahattamāḥ||1||

etat — this; te — to you; kathitam — has been told; sutram — in brief, as a sutra; shri-krishna-charitam — the life of Sri Krishna; dvija — O brahmana; varnayishyanti — will describe; vistaraih — in detail; shrivasa-adyah — Srivasa and others; mahattamah — the greatest souls.

1So, brahmana1, I have told you the life of Sri Krishna in brief, like a sutra; Srivasa and other great souls will describe it in detail.

Verse 2

अत्रानुवर्ण्यतेऽभीक्ष्णं श्रीगौराङ्गो महाप्रभुः।
फलास्वादनिमित्तेन कथ्यते तदनुक्रमः॥२॥

atrānuvarṇyate'bhīkṣṇaṁ śrīgaurāṅgo mahāprabhuḥ|
phalāsvādanimittena kathyate tadanukramaḥ||2||

atra — here (in this book); anuvarnyate — is described; abhikshnam — again and again; shri-gaurangah — Sri Gauranga; maha-prabhuh — Mahaprabhu; phala-asvada-nimittena — for the sake of tasting the fruit; kathyate — is told; tad-anukramah — its sequence.

2Here Sri Gauranga Mahaprabhu is described again and again; and now, so that the fruit of the narrative may be tasted, its sequence is set out.

Verse 3

अवतारकारणञ्च श्रीकृष्णस्य विचेष्टितम्।
बहिर्मुखान् जनान् दृष्ट्वा नारदस्यानुतापनम्॥३॥

avatārakāraṇañca śrīkṛṣṇasya viceṣṭitam|
bahirmukhān janān dṛṣṭvā nāradasyānutāpanam||3||

avatara-karanam — the reason for the descent; cha — and; shri-krishnasya — of Sri Krishna; vicheshtitam — the deeds; bahir-mukhan — turned away (from God); janan — people; drishtva — seeing; naradasya — Narada's; anutapanam — sorrow.

3The reason for Sri Krishna's descent, and His deeds; the sorrow of Narada on seeing people turned away from God;

Verse 4

वैकुण्ठगमनञ्चापि श्रीकृष्णेनापि सान्त्वनम्।
सर्वेषामवताराणां कथनं कृष्णजन्म च॥४॥

vaikuṇṭhagamanañcāpi śrīkṛṣṇenāpi sāntvanam|
sarveṣāmavatārāṇāṁ kathanaṁ kṛṣṇajanma ca||4||

vaikuntha-gamanam — the journey to Vaikuntha; cha api — and also; shri-krishnena — by Sri Krishna; api — and; santvanam — consolation; sarvesham — of all; avataranam — the avataras; kathanam — the account; krishna-janma — the birth of Krishna; cha — and.

4his journey to Vaikuntha and the consolation Sri Krishna gave him; the account of all the avataras, and the birth of Krishna2;

Verse 5

बाल्यलीलादिकञ्चैव ब्राह्मणस्यान्नभोजनम्।
विश्वरूपस्य सन्न्यासं नित्यानन्दात्मकस्य च॥५॥

bālyalīlādikañcaiva brāhmaṇasyānnabhojanam|
viśvarūpasya sannyāsaṁ nityānandātmakasya ca||5||

balya-lila-adikam — the childhood pastimes and so on; cha eva — and; brahmanasya — of the brahmana; anna-bhojanam — the eating of the food; vishvarupasya — of Vishvarupa; sannyasam — the sannyasa; nityananda-atmakasya — whose essence is Nityananda; cha — and.

5the childhood pastimes and the rest; how He ate the wandering brahmana's food; the sannyasa of Vishvarupa, whose essence is Nityananda3;

Verse 6

जगन्नाथस्य संस्थानं दुःखशोकानुवर्णनम्।
विद्याविलासलावण्यं मातृदुःखविमोचनम्॥६॥

jagannāthasya saṁsthānaṁ duḥkhaśokānuvarṇanam|
vidyāvilāsalāvaṇyaṁ mātṛduḥkhavimocanam||6||

jagannathasya — of Jagannatha (Mishra); samsthanam — the passing; duhkha-shoka-anuvarnanam — the description of grief and sorrow; vidya-vilasa-lavanyam — the charm of the pastimes of learning; matri-duhkha-vimochanam — the freeing of the mother from grief.

6the passing of Jagannatha Mishra and the account of grief and sorrow; the charm of His pastimes of learning; how He freed His mother from grief;

Verse 7

लक्ष्मीपरिणयञ्चैव पूर्वदेशे गते प्रभौ।
तस्याः संस्थितिरेव स्यात् शचीशोकापनोदनम्॥७॥

lakṣmīpariṇayañcaiva pūrvadeśe gate prabhau|
tasyāḥ saṁsthitireva syāt śacīśokāpanodanam||7||

lakshmi-parinayam — the marriage with Lakshmi; cha eva — and; purva-deshe — to the eastern land; gate — when He had gone; prabhau — the Prabhu; tasyah — her; samsthitih — passing; eva — indeed; syat — was; shachi-shoka-apanodanam — the dispelling of Shachi's grief.

7the marriage with Lakshmi; her passing while the Prabhu had gone to the eastern land; the consoling of grieving Shachi;

Verse 8

विष्णुप्रियापरिणयं परमानन्दवैभवम्।
पुरीश्वरदर्शनञ्च गयाकृत्यसमापनम्॥८॥

viṣṇupriyāpariṇayaṁ paramānandavaibhavam|
purīśvaradarśanañca gayākṛtyasamāpanam||8||

vishnupriya-parinayam — the marriage with Vishnupriya; parama-ananda-vaibhavam — a splendour of supreme bliss; puri-ishvara-darshanam — the meeting with (Ishvara) Puri; cha — and; gaya-kritya-samapanam — the completion of the rites at Gaya.

8the marriage with Vishnupriya, a splendour of supreme bliss; the meeting with Ishvara Puri and the completion of the rites at Gaya;

Verse 9

भावप्रकाशनञ्चैव वराहवेशधारणम्।
संकीर्तनशुभारम्भं मेघनिःसारणं तथा॥९॥

bhāvaprakāśanañcaiva varāhaveśadhāraṇam|
saṁkīrtanaśubhārambhaṁ meghaniḥsāraṇaṁ tathā||9||

bhava-prakashanam — the manifestation of ecstatic feelings; cha eva — and; varaha-vesha-dharanam — assuming the form of the Boar; sankirtana-shubha-arambham — the auspicious beginning of sankirtana; megha-nihsaranam — the driving away of the clouds; tatha — likewise.

9the manifestation of ecstatic feelings and the form of the Boar; the auspicious beginning of sankirtana and the driving away of the clouds;

Verse 10

नामार्थकल्पनादेव गङ्गापतननिर्गमम्।
अधीनं भक्तवर्गाणां श्रीलाद्वैतस्य मेलनम्॥१०॥

nāmārthakalpanādeva gaṅgāpatananirgamam|
adhīnaṁ bhaktavargāṇāṁ śrīlādvaitasya melanam||10||

nama-artha-kalpanat — because of a fanciful interpretation of the Name; eva — indeed; ganga-patana-nirgamam — the going away and plunging into the Ganga; adhinam — submission; bhakta-varganam — to the hosts of devotees; shrila-advaitasya — with Srila Advaita; melanam — the meeting.

10His going away and plunging into the Ganga because of a false interpretation of the holy Name4; the Lord's submission to the hosts of devotees; the meeting with Srila Advaita;

Verse 11

भक्तानुकम्पनञ्चैव श्रीनित्यानन्ददर्शनम्।
षड्भुजदर्शनानन्दं बलरामप्रकाशकम्॥११॥

bhaktānukampanañcaiva śrīnityānandadarśanam|
ṣaḍbhujadarśanānandaṁ balarāmaprakāśakam||11||

bhakta-anukampanam — mercy to the devotees; cha eva — and; shri-nityananda-darshanam — the meeting with Sri Nityananda; shad-bhuja-darshana-anandam — the bliss of beholding the six-armed form; balarama-prakashakam — revealing Balarama.

11mercy to the devotees; the meeting with Sri Nityananda; the bliss of beholding the six-armed form, which revealed Balarama;

Verse 12

भक्तिरससमाकृष्टं हरेर्मन्दिरमार्जनम्।
भक्तदत्तग्रहणञ्च महैश्वर्यप्रदर्शनम्॥१२॥

bhaktirasasamākṛṣṭaṁ harermandiramārjanam|
bhaktadattagrahaṇañca mahaiśvaryapradarśanam||12||

bhakti-rasa-samakrishtam — drawn by the rasa of bhakti; hareh — of Hari; mandira-marjanam — the cleansing of the temple; bhakta-datta-grahanam — the accepting of the devotees' gifts; cha — and; maha-aishvarya-pradarshanam — the display of great majesty.

12the cleansing of Hari's temple, to which the rasa of bhakti drew Him; the accepting of the devotees' gifts and the display of great majesty;

Verse 13

नृत्यगानविलासादि गङ्गामज्जनमेव च।
ब्रह्मशापवरञ्चैव जीवनिस्तारहेतुकम्॥१३॥

nṛtyagānavilāsādi gaṅgāmajjanameva ca|
brahmaśāpavarañcaiva jīvanistārahetukam||13||

nritya-gana-vilasa-adi — the pastimes of dancing and singing and so on; ganga-majjanam — the plunge into the Ganga; eva cha — and; brahma-shapa-varam — the brahmana's curse as a boon; cha eva — and; jiva-nistara-hetukam — which became the cause of the deliverance of living beings.

13the pastimes of dancing, singing and the rest; the plunge into the Ganga; the brahmana's curse, which turned into a blessing and became the cause of the deliverance of living beings;

Verse 14

बलरामरसावेशमधुपानादिनर्तनम्।
गोपीवेशधरं नृत्यगानमाधुर्यवर्णनम्॥१४॥

balarāmarasāveśamadhupānādinartanam|
gopīveśadharaṁ nṛtyagānamādhuryavarṇanam||14||

balarama-rasa-avesha-madhu-pana-adi-nartanam — absorption in Balarama's rasa, drinking of honey, dancing and the rest; gopi-vesha-dharam — (Him) in the dress of a gopi; nritya-gana-madhurya-varnanam — the description of the sweetness of the dancing and singing.

14absorption in Balarama's rasa, the drinking of honey, the dancing and the rest; the Lord in the dress of a gopi, and the description of the sweetness of His dancing and singing;

Verse 15

सन्न्यासोपक्रमे गुप्तमुरार्यादिकसान्त्वनम्।
नवद्वीपकण्टकाख्यपुरवासिविलापनम्॥१५॥

sannyāsopakrame guptamurāryādikasāntvanam|
navadvīpakaṇṭakākhyapuravāsivilāpanam||15||

sannyasa-upakrame — at the beginning of sannyasa; gupta-murari-adika-santvanam — the consoling of Murari Gupta and others; navadvipa-kantaka-akhya-pura-vasi-vilapanam — the lament of the residents of Navadvipa and of the town called Kantaka.

15the consoling of Murari Gupta and others before the sannyasa; the lament of the people of Navadvipa and of the town of Kantaka5;

Verse 16

सन्न्यासनामग्रहणं प्रेमानन्दप्रकाशनम्।
राढदेशकृतार्थञ्च चन्द्रशेखरप्रेषणम्॥१६॥

sannyāsanāmagrahaṇaṁ premānandaprakāśanam|
rāḍhadeśakṛtārthañca candraśekharapreṣaṇam||16||

sannyasa-nama-grahanam — the taking of the sannyasa name; prema-ananda-prakashanam — the manifestation of the bliss of prema; radha-desha-kritartham — the blessing of the Radha country; cha — and; chandrashekhara-preshanam — the sending of Chandrashekhara.

16the taking of the sannyasa name and the manifestation of the bliss of prema; the blessing of the Radha country and the sending of Chandrashekhara;

Verse 17

नवद्वीपस्य च नित्यानन्देन दुःखनाशनम्।
शान्तिपुरविलासञ्च भक्तवर्गसमन्वितम्॥१७॥

navadvīpasya ca nityānandena duḥkhanāśanam|
śāntipuravilāsañca bhaktavargasamanvitam||17||

navadvipasya — of Navadvipa; cha — and; nityanandena — through Nityananda; duhkha-nashanam — the ending of the grief; shantipura-vilasam — the pastimes at Shantipura; cha — and; bhakta-varga-samanvitam — among the devotees.

17how Nityananda ended Navadvipa's grief; the pastimes at Shantipura among the devotees;

Verse 18

ततो दण्डभञ्जनं श्रीगोपीनाथस्य दर्शनम्।
वराहदर्शनं पुण्यं विरजादर्शनं तथा॥१८॥

tato daṇḍabhañjanaṁ śrīgopīnāthasya darśanam|
varāhadarśanaṁ puṇyaṁ virajādarśanaṁ tathā||18||

tatah — then; danda-bhanjanam — the breaking of the staff; shri-gopinathasya — of Sri Gopinatha; darshanam — the darshan; varaha-darshanam — the darshan of the Boar; punyam — holy; viraja-darshanam — the darshan of Viraja; tatha — likewise.

18then the breaking of the staff; the darshan of Sri Gopinatha; the holy darshan of the Boar, and also of Viraja;

Verse 19

वैतरणीयाजपुरश्रीशिवलिङ्गदर्शनम्।
नानाभावप्रकाशं श्रीभुवनेश्वरदर्शनम्॥१९॥

vaitaraṇīyājapuraśrīśivaliṅgadarśanam|
nānābhāvaprakāśaṁ śrībhuvaneśvaradarśanam||19||

vaitarani-yajapura-shri-shiva-linga-darshanam — the sight of the Vaitarani, of Yajapura and of the holy Shiva-lingas; nana-bhava-prakasham — the manifestation of many feelings; shri-bhuvaneshvara-darshanam — the darshan of Sri Bhuvaneshvara.

19the Vaitarani, Yajapura and the holy Shiva-lingas; the manifestation of many feelings; the darshan of Sri Bhuvaneshvara;

Verse 20

निर्माल्यग्रहणस्यापि विधानकथनं शुभम्।
श्रीमन्दिरस्थगोपालदर्शनं रोदनं प्रभोः॥२०॥

nirmālyagrahaṇasyāpi vidhānakathanaṁ śubham|
śrīmandirasthagopāladarśanaṁ rodanaṁ prabhoḥ||20||

nirmalya-grahanasya — of accepting the remnants of offerings; api — also; vidhana-kathanam — the exposition of the rule; shubham — auspicious; shri-mandira-stha-gopala-darshanam — the vision of Gopala upon the temple; rodanam — the weeping; prabhoh — of the Prabhu.

20the auspicious exposition of the rule on accepting the remnants of offerings6; the vision of Gopala upon the temple and the Prabhu's weeping7;

Verse 21

मार्कण्डेयसरस्येव शिवलिङ्गप्रदर्शनम्।
ततः श्रीमज्जगन्नाथदर्शनानन्दवैभवम्॥२१॥

mārkaṇḍeyasarasyeva śivaliṅgapradarśanam|
tataḥ śrīmajjagannāthadarśanānandavaibhavam||21||

markandeya-sarasi — at the lake of Markandeya; eva — indeed; shiva-linga-pradarshanam — the darshan of the Shiva-linga; tatah — then; shrimaj-jagannatha-darshana-ananda-vaibhavam — the splendour of the bliss of beholding Sri Jagannatha.

21the darshan of the Shiva-linga at the lake of Markandeya; then the splendour of the bliss of beholding Sri Jagannatha;

Verse 22

सार्वभौमादिभिः सार्धं पुनः श्रीमुखदर्शनम्।
श्रीमन्महाप्रसादस्य वन्दनं भोजनं शुभम्॥२२॥

sārvabhaumādibhiḥ sārdhaṁ punaḥ śrīmukhadarśanam|
śrīmanmahāprasādasya vandanaṁ bhojanaṁ śubham||22||

sarvabhauma-adibhih — with Sarvabhauma and others; sardham — together; punah — again; shri-mukha-darshanam — the darshan of the holy face; shriman-mahaprasadasya — of the holy mahaprasada; vandanam — the honouring; bhojanam — the partaking; shubham — auspicious.

22the renewed darshan of His holy face together with Sarvabhauma and others; the auspicious honouring and partaking of the holy mahaprasada;

Verse 23

सार्वभौमसमुद्धारं दक्षिणगमनं हरेः।
कूर्मनाथदर्शनञ्च कूर्मविप्रानुकम्पनम्॥२३॥

sārvabhaumasamuddhāraṁ dakṣiṇagamanaṁ hareḥ|
kūrmanāthadarśanañca kūrmaviprānukampanam||23||

sarvabhauma-samuddharam — the deliverance of Sarvabhauma; dakshina-gamanam — the journey south; hareh — of Hari; kurma-natha-darshanam — the darshan of Kurmanatha; cha — and; kurma-vipra-anukampanam — the mercy to the brahmana Kurma.

23the deliverance of Sarvabhauma; Hari's journey south; the darshan of Kurmanatha and the mercy to the brahmana Kurma;

Verse 24

वासुदेवसमुद्धारं शक्तिसञ्चारणं तथा।
जियडाख्यनृसिंहस्य चरित्रास्वादनं सुखम्॥२४॥

vāsudevasamuddhāraṁ śaktisañcāraṇaṁ tathā|
jiyaḍākhyanṛsiṁhasya caritrāsvādanaṁ sukham||24||

vasudeva-samuddharam — the deliverance of Vasudeva; shakti-sancharanam — the imparting of power; tatha — likewise; jiyada-akhya-nrisimhasya — of the Nrisimha called Jiyada; charitra-asvadanam — the relishing of the story; sukham — joyful.

24the deliverance of Vasudeva8 and the imparting of power; the joyful relishing of the story of the Nrisimha called Jiyada;

Verse 25

श्रीलरामानन्दरायमिलनं शुभदं शुभम्।
पुरीश्रीमाधवशिष्यपरमानन्ददर्शनम्॥२५॥

śrīlarāmānandarāyamilanaṁ śubhadaṁ śubham|
purīśrīmādhavaśiṣyaparamānandadarśanam||25||

shrila-ramananda-raya-milanam — the meeting with Srila Ramananda Raya; shubha-dam — bestowing good; shubham — auspicious; puri-shri-madhava-shishya-paramananda-darshanam — the meeting with Paramananda Puri, the disciple of Sri Madhava.

25the auspicious meeting with Srila Ramananda Raya, which bestows all good; the meeting with Paramananda Puri, the disciple of Sri Madhava;

Verse 26

पञ्चवटीरङ्गक्षेत्ररङ्गनाथप्रदर्शनम्।
तत्र श्रीपरमानन्दपुरीप्रस्थापनं प्रभोः॥२६॥

pañcavaṭīraṅgakṣetraraṅganāthapradarśanam|
tatra śrīparamānandapurīprasthāpanaṁ prabhoḥ||26||

panchavati-ranga-kshetra-ranganatha-pradarshanam — the sight of Panchavati, Ranga-kshetra and Ranganatha; tatra — there; shri-paramananda-puri-prasthapanam — the sending on of Sri Paramananda Puri; prabhoh — by the Prabhu.

26the darshan of Panchavati, Ranga-kshetra and Ranganatha; how the Prabhu sent Sri Paramananda Puri on from there to the Kshetra;

Verse 27

सेतुबन्धे श्रीलरामेश्वरलिङ्गप्रदर्शनम्।
ततः श्रीमज्जगन्नाथदर्शनानन्दवर्णनम्॥२७॥

setubandhe śrīlarāmeśvaraliṅgapradarśanam|
tataḥ śrīmajjagannāthadarśanānandavarṇanam||27||

setubandhe — at Setubandha; shrila-rameshvara-linga-pradarshanam — the darshan of the linga of Sri Rameshvara; tatah — then; shrimaj-jagannatha-darshana-ananda-varnanam — the description of the bliss of beholding Sri Jagannatha.

27the darshan of the linga of Sri Rameshvara at Setubandha; then the description of the bliss of beholding Sri Jagannatha;

Verse 28

वृन्दारण्यं समुद्दिश्य गौडाभिगमनं शुभम्।
वाचस्पतिगृहे कृष्णवैभवं परमाद्भुतम्॥२८॥

vṛndāraṇyaṁ samuddiśya gauḍābhigamanaṁ śubham|
vācaspatigṛhe kṛṣṇavaibhavaṁ paramādbhutam||28||

vrindaranyam — Vrindaranya; samuddishya — aiming for; gauda-abhigamanam — the journey to Gauda; shubham — auspicious; vachaspati-grihe — in Vachaspati's house; krishna-vaibhavam — Krishna's majesty; parama-adbhutam — most wondrous.

28the auspicious journey to Gauda with the aim of going to Vrindaranya; the most wondrous majesty of Krishna in Vachaspati's house;

Verse 29

देवानन्दं समुद्दिश्य श्रीभागवतकीर्तनम्।
तद्वक्तृलक्षणञ्चापि श्रोतुश्च कथितं शुभम्॥२९॥

devānandaṁ samuddiśya śrībhāgavatakīrtanam|
tadvaktṛlakṣaṇañcāpi śrotuśca kathitaṁ śubham||29||

devanandam — to Devananda; samuddishya — addressing; shri-bhagavata-kirtanam — the glorification of the Srimad-Bhagavatam; tad-vaktri-lakshanam — the marks of its reciter; cha api — and also; shrotuh — of the hearer; cha — and; kathitam — set forth; shubham — auspicious.

29the glorification of the Srimad-Bhagavatam addressed to Devananda, and the auspicious account of the marks of its reciter and of its hearer;

Verse 30

श्रीनृसिंहानन्देन यत् कृतं जङ्घालमुत्तमम्।
तेन यथा रामकेलिकृष्णनाट्यस्थलावधि॥३०॥

śrīnṛsiṁhānandena yat kṛtaṁ jaṅghālamuttamam|
tena yathā rāmakelikṛṣṇanāṭyasthalāvadhi||30||

shri-nrisimhanandena — by Sri Nrisimhananda; yat — which; kritam — was made; janghalam — the raised road; uttamam — excellent; tena — along it; yatha — as; ramakeli-krishna-natya-sthala-avadhi — as far as Ramakeli and the place of Krishna's dancing.

30the excellent road laid by Sri Nrisimhananda9, and how along it, as far as Ramakeli and the place of Krishna's dancing10,

Verse 31

गमनञ्च पुनः श्रीलाद्वैतगेहशुभागमः।
नवद्वीपभक्तवर्गमेलनं पुनरेव च॥३१॥

gamanañca punaḥ śrīlādvaitagehaśubhāgamaḥ|
navadvīpabhaktavargamelanaṁ punareva ca||31||

gamanam — the journey; cha — and; punah — again; shrila-advaita-geha-shubha-agamah — the auspicious coming to Srila Advaita's house; navadvipa-bhakta-varga-melanam — the meeting with the devotees of Navadvipa; punah eva — once more; cha — and.

31the Lord journeyed; then the auspicious coming to Srila Advaita's house and the meeting once more with the devotees of Navadvipa;

Verse 32

श्रीभोजनसुखं तत्र मातुश्चरणवन्दनम्।
पुरुषोत्तममासाद्य श्रीगोपीनाथदर्शनम्॥३२॥

śrībhojanasukhaṁ tatra mātuścaraṇavandanam|
puruṣottamamāsādya śrīgopīnāthadarśanam||32||

shri-bhojana-sukham — the joy of the holy meal; tatra — there; matuh — of the mother; charana-vandanam — the worship of the feet; purushottamam — Purushottama; asadya — having reached; shri-gopinatha-darshanam — the darshan of Sri Gopinatha.

32the joy of the holy meal and the worship of His mother's feet; and, on reaching Purushottama, the darshan of Sri Gopinatha11.

Thus ends the twenty-fifth sarga, "The Account from the Birth of Sri Krishna to the Darshan of Gopinatha" (Shri-krishna-janmadi-gopinatha-darshana-paryanta-kathana), in the "Recapitulation of the Book" (Grantha-anukathana), of the fourth prakrama of the poem "Sri Krishna-chaitanya-charitamrita."

✦

Notes

  1. Damodara Pandita, to whom Murari narrates the poem (cf. 1.02.15). Verses 3–32 list the contents of the first three prakramas of the poem.
  2. That is, the appearance of Sri Krishna Chaitanya (1.05).
  3. According to Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition, Vishvarupa, after taking sannyasa, entered into Nityananda (Balarama).
  4. Cf. 2.04.33–34: hearing a brahmana's son speak slightingly of Krishna, the Lord went away and plunged into the Ganga together with His students.
  5. Kantaka: Kantakanagara (Katwa), where the Lord took sannyasa.
  6. The remnants of offerings to Shiva at Bhubaneshvara (3.09).
  7. Above the temple of Jagannatha a boy with a flute appeared to the Lord (3.10).
  8. The leper brahmana whom the Lord healed at Kurma-kshetra (3.14).
  9. The road that Nrisimhananda laid out for the Lord in his mind (3.17.6–9); the word in the text apparently means a raised road or causeway.
  10. Kanai Natyashala, from where the Lord turned back (3.17–3.18).
  11. Gadadhara Pandita's Deity in Puri (3.18.23–27).
